notes: NDM 1.8.2 — the full IDM audit release. Every function of the app and extension was compared against IDM one by one and aligned: unified categories with IDM folder routing, per-server connection limits, duplicate downloads ask first (IDM-style), automatic retries (10x, 30s apart, permanent errors excluded), Download Complete dialog, completion sounds, exit-when-done. The dialogs now start the download while they are open, exactly like IDM's File Info: Start keeps it, Download Later pauses it in the app, Cancel discards it completely. Plus IDM's Scheduler queues (named queues, each with its own window, simultaneous cap and exit-when-done), Download limits (quota per period), clipboard link monitoring, the per-connection progress table, login/password authorization on Add URL, and Download all for videos. Default connection number is now 8, IDM's default.
